# Test: Rollback from split-rootfs when controller connectivity is lost
# Scenario: monolith -> split (fully working) -> controller disconnect -> rollback
#
# This test verifies that Extension cleanup (unmount, verity close, file delete)
# works correctly when rollback is triggered while Extension is fully loaded
# and services are running. The rollback is caused by controller disconnect
# (host-side network drop to Adam), not by Extension failure.
#
# Flow:
#   1. Start on monolithic 15.11.0
#   2. OTA to good split image
#   3. Wait for Extension to fully load (services running, SSH available)
#   4. Drop host-side traffic from EVE to Adam
#   5. EVE detects controller unreachable → fallback timeout → reboot
#   6. EVE rolls back to monolithic 15.11.0
#   7. Remove the host-side drop, verify rollback, verify Extension cleaned up
#
# Env vars:
#   EVE_VERSION  - split-rootfs EVE version tag (required)
#   EVE_REGISTRY - OCI registry path (default: lfedge/eve)
#   SPLIT_WORKFLOW_NO_RESET - skip final `eden eve reset` when running inside a workflow

{{$eve_ver := "0.0.0"}}
{{$eve_registry := "lfedge/eve"}}

{{$env := EdenGetEnv "EVE_VERSION"}}
{{if $env}}{{$eve_ver = $env}}{{end}}

{{$env_reg := EdenGetEnv "EVE_REGISTRY"}}
{{if $env_reg}}{{$eve_registry = $env_reg}}{{end}}

{{$eve_hv := "kvm"}}
{{$env_hv := EdenGetEnv "EVE_HV"}}
{{if $env_hv}}{{$eve_hv = $env_hv}}{{end}}
{{$eve_arch := EdenConfig "eve.arch"}}
{{$short_version := printf "%s-%s-%s" $eve_ver $eve_hv $eve_arch}}
{{$test_info := "test eden.lim.test -test.v -timewait 30m -test.run TestInfo"}}
{{$skip_reset := EdenGetEnv "SPLIT_WORKFLOW_NO_RESET"}}

# Obtain the monolithic version we expect to roll back to
{{$mono_ver := EdenConfig "eve.tag"}}
{{$mono_hv := EdenConfig "eve.hv"}}
{{$mono_short := printf "%s-%s-%s" $mono_ver $mono_hv $eve_arch}}

# ── Step 1: Verify monolithic base ──────────────────────────
message 'Disconnect-Rollback: verifying monolithic base...'
eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo split || echo monolithic'
stdout 'monolithic'

# ── Step 2: Send OTA to good split image ─────────────────────
# Set short fallback-on-disconnect timeout and controller send timeout so a
# host-side DROP rule is detected as unavailable quickly.
message 'Disconnect-Rollback: ensuring no stale host drop is present...'
exec bash cleanup-adam-drop.sh

eden controller edge-node update --config timer.test.baseimage.update=600
eden controller edge-node update --config timer.update.fallback.no.network=60
eden controller edge-node update --config timer.send.timeout=10

message 'Disconnect-Rollback: sending split image update...'
eden -t 10m controller edge-node eveimage-update oci://docker.io/{{$eve_registry}}:{{$eve_ver}}-{{$eve_hv}}-{{$eve_arch}} -m adam://
! stderr .

# ── Step 3: Wait for split to boot (inprogress) and Extension to load ──
# We wait for inprogress (not active) because we'll disconnect Adam before
# the testing window completes, so the update never reaches active state.
message 'Disconnect-Rollback: waiting for split image to boot (inprogress)...'
{{$test_info}} -out InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion 'InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].PartitionState:inprogress InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion:{{ $short_version }}'
stdout '{{ $short_version }}'

message 'Disconnect-Rollback: waiting for Extension services (SSH)...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-ssh.sh

message 'Disconnect-Rollback: waiting for Extension mount...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-extsloader.sh

# Verify Extension is fully working before we disconnect
eden eve ssh 'mountpoint -q /persist/exts && echo mounted || echo not-mounted'
stdout 'mounted'

eden eve ssh 'ls /dev/mapper/exts-verity-* 2>/dev/null && echo verity-active || echo no-verity'
stdout 'verity-active'

message 'Disconnect-Rollback: Extension fully loaded, services running'

# ── Step 4: Block EVE -> Adam on the host ────────────────────
# Host-side DROP avoids touching the guest while also avoiding ECONNREFUSED
# from a stopped controller socket. Adam is exposed through a Docker published
# port, so we block the resolved container endpoint and cover both locally
# originated traffic (OUTPUT) and forwarded traffic (DOCKER-USER).
# With timer.send.timeout=10, EVE should treat Adam as unavailable quickly
# enough for the 60s fallback timer to expire.
# Before rebooting, nodeagent cleans up Extension (lazy unmount + delete).
# The helper removes the DROP rule on exit, even if it fails internally.
message 'Disconnect-Rollback: blocking EVE -> Adam on the host for 150s...'
exec bash disconnect-window.sh 150

# ── Step 5: Wait for rollback to monolithic ──────────────────
# EVE will detect controller unreachable → 60s fallback timeout →
# cleanup Extension → reboot → fall back to monolithic.
# Adam is restored by disconnect-window.sh before we query the final state.

message 'Disconnect-Rollback: waiting for monolithic to become active...'
{{$test_info}} -out InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion 'InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].PartitionState:active InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion:{{ $mono_short }}'
stdout '{{ $mono_short }}'

# ── Step 6: Wait for SSH and verify ──────────────────────────
message 'Disconnect-Rollback: waiting for SSH...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-ssh.sh

message 'Disconnect-Rollback: verifying rollback state...'

eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo split || echo monolithic'
stdout 'monolithic'

eden eve ssh 'echo alive'
stdout 'alive'

# Extension from split partition should be cleaned up before rollback
eden eve ssh 'count=$(ls /persist/ext-img*.img 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "ext-img-count:$count"'
stdout 'ext-img-count:0'

# No GRUB HV menu should appear on any boot
exec bash check-no-grub-menu.sh

# "uni" must never reach runtime — check both the final value and that the
# safety fallback in onboot.sh was never triggered
eden eve ssh 'cat /hostfs/run/eve-hv-type 2>/dev/null | grep -qx uni && echo uni-leaked || echo hv-ok'
stdout 'hv-ok'
eden eve ssh 'logread | grep -q "eve-hv-type resolved to .uni." && echo uni-safety-triggered || echo clean-resolve'
stdout 'clean-resolve'

message 'Disconnect-Rollback: SUCCESS - rollback with running services, Extension cleaned up'

{{if $skip_reset}}{{else}}
# Reset config
eden eve reset
{{end}}

# Test's config file
-- eden-config.yml --
test:
    controller: adam://{{EdenConfig "adam.ip"}}:{{EdenConfig "adam.port"}}
    eve:
      {{EdenConfig "eve.name"}}:
        onboard-cert: {{EdenConfigPath "eve.cert"}}
        serial: "{{EdenConfig "eve.serial"}}"
        model: {{EdenConfig "eve.devmodel"}}

-- wait-ssh.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
i=0
while [ $i -lt 30 ]; do
    if timeout 10 $EDEN eve ssh echo ssh-ready 2>/dev/null; then
        exit 0
    fi
    sleep 5
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "SSH not available after 150s"
exit 1

-- wait-extsloader.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
i=0
while [ $i -lt 24 ]; do
    MOUNTED=$($EDEN eve ssh 'mountpoint -q /persist/exts && echo yes || echo no' 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$MOUNTED" = "yes" ]; then
        echo "Extension mounted at /persist/exts"
        exit 0
    fi
    echo "Waiting for Extension mount (attempt $((i+1))/24)..."
    sleep 10
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "Extension not mounted after 240s"
exit 1

-- disconnect-window.sh --
set -eu

CHAIN=DOCKER-USER
OUTPUT_CHAIN=OUTPUT
COMMENT_FWD=eden-update-split-disconnect-fwd
COMMENT_OUT=eden-update-split-disconnect-out
ADAM_CONTAINER_IP=$(docker inspect eden_adam | awk -F'"' '/"IPAddress": "[0-9]/{print $4; exit}')
ADAM_CONTAINER_PORT=8080
RULE_FWD=(-p tcp -d "$ADAM_CONTAINER_IP" --dport "$ADAM_CONTAINER_PORT" -m comment --comment "$COMMENT_FWD" -j DROP)
RULE_OUT=(-p tcp -d "$ADAM_CONTAINER_IP" --dport "$ADAM_CONTAINER_PORT" -m comment --comment "$COMMENT_OUT" -j DROP)
WAIT_SECONDS="${1:-150}"

if [ -z "$ADAM_CONTAINER_IP" ]; then
    echo "failed to resolve eden_adam container IP"
    exit 1
fi

if ! sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "passwordless sudo or a cached sudo session is required for iptables; run 'sudo -v' before this test"
    exit 1
fi

if ! sudo -n iptables -w -nL "$CHAIN" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "iptables chain $CHAIN is not available"
    exit 1
fi

if ! sudo -n iptables -w -nL "$OUTPUT_CHAIN" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "iptables chain $OUTPUT_CHAIN is not available"
    exit 1
fi

cleanup() {
    bash cleanup-adam-drop.sh
}

trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

echo "Blocking Adam container endpoint ${ADAM_CONTAINER_IP}:${ADAM_CONTAINER_PORT}"

if sudo -n iptables -w -C "$CHAIN" "${RULE_FWD[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Host FORWARD DROP rule already present"
else
    echo "Adding host FORWARD DROP rule for Adam..."
    sudo -n iptables -w -I "$CHAIN" 1 "${RULE_FWD[@]}"
fi

if sudo -n iptables -w -C "$OUTPUT_CHAIN" "${RULE_OUT[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Host OUTPUT DROP rule already present"
else
    echo "Adding host OUTPUT DROP rule for Adam..."
    sudo -n iptables -w -I "$OUTPUT_CHAIN" 1 "${RULE_OUT[@]}"
fi

echo "Host DROP rule active for ${WAIT_SECONDS}s"
sleep "$WAIT_SECONDS"

-- cleanup-adam-drop.sh --
set -eu

CHAIN=DOCKER-USER
OUTPUT_CHAIN=OUTPUT
COMMENT_FWD=eden-update-split-disconnect-fwd
COMMENT_OUT=eden-update-split-disconnect-out
ADAM_CONTAINER_IP=$(docker inspect eden_adam | awk -F'"' '/"IPAddress": "[0-9]/{print $4; exit}')
ADAM_CONTAINER_PORT=8080
RULE_FWD=(-p tcp -d "$ADAM_CONTAINER_IP" --dport "$ADAM_CONTAINER_PORT" -m comment --comment "$COMMENT_FWD" -j DROP)
RULE_OUT=(-p tcp -d "$ADAM_CONTAINER_IP" --dport "$ADAM_CONTAINER_PORT" -m comment --comment "$COMMENT_OUT" -j DROP)

if [ -z "$ADAM_CONTAINER_IP" ]; then
    echo "failed to resolve eden_adam container IP"
    exit 1
fi

if ! sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "passwordless sudo or a cached sudo session is required for iptables; run 'sudo -v' before this test"
    exit 1
fi

if ! sudo -n iptables -w -nL "$CHAIN" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "iptables chain $CHAIN is not available"
    exit 1
fi

if ! sudo -n iptables -w -nL "$OUTPUT_CHAIN" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "iptables chain $OUTPUT_CHAIN is not available"
    exit 1
fi

while sudo -n iptables -w -C "$CHAIN" "${RULE_FWD[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    echo "Removing host FORWARD DROP rule for Adam..."
    sudo -n iptables -w -D "$CHAIN" "${RULE_FWD[@]}"
done

while sudo -n iptables -w -C "$OUTPUT_CHAIN" "${RULE_OUT[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    echo "Removing host OUTPUT DROP rule for Adam..."
    sudo -n iptables -w -D "$OUTPUT_CHAIN" "${RULE_OUT[@]}"
done

sleep 5
echo "Host DROP rule removed"

-- check-no-grub-menu.sh --
#!/bin/bash
# Verify that NO boot in the current QEMU session showed the HV selection menu.
# The serial log uses logappend=on, so it may contain entries from previous runs.
# We only check from the LAST "swtpm is starting" line (marks current session).
EVE_LOG={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/default-eve.log

if [ ! -f "$EVE_LOG" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: EVE serial log not found at $EVE_LOG"
    exit 1
fi

# Extract current session: everything after the last "swtpm is starting"
CURRENT=$(tac "$EVE_LOG" | sed '/swtpm is starting/q' | tac)

if echo "$CURRENT" | grep -q "Boot/Install EVE"; then
    echo "FAIL: GRUB HV selection menu appeared during a boot!"
    echo "--- GRUB menu lines in current session ---"
    echo "$CURRENT" | grep -E "Boot/Install|Boot 0\." | head -10
    exit 1
fi

echo "OK: No GRUB HV selection menu on any boot in current session"
